claims: `isZeroWei` crashes the revenue page on any non-string field value — a regression this change introduces (`ui-dashboard/src/lib/canonical-revenue/daily-series.ts:67`): `.trim()` is called outside the try, so `null`/`undefined`/numeric values throw `TypeError` instead of degrading to the partial banner
The `try/catch` guards `BigInt(trimmed)`, which the regex has already guaranteed cannot throw — the protection sits on the safe operation while `.trim()` is left bare
`isZeroWei` newly reads `balanceAmount` and `principalAmount`, which no prior code path touched at all

Rows arrive unvalidated: `use-reserve-yield-history.ts:185` does a bare `requestWithTimeout<ReserveYieldHistoryResponse>` generic cast, and `pageRowsForResponse` (`:196`) pushes them straight through — the `string` typing is an assertion, not a runtime check

The throw escapes `buildCanonicalRevenue` inside the `useMemo` at `use-canonical-revenue.ts:53`, i.e. during render — the revenue page dies to the nearest error boundary rather than degrading to the partial banner

No test for the dormant → funded handoff: a wallet whose all-zero rows precede its first funded row now seeds `previousReserveTotalsBySource` with `0` (`daily-series.ts:204`) and nothing pins this sequence
Worth adding `null`/numeric cases to that existing `it.each` block (missing test coverage for non-string inputs to `isZeroWei`)

judge_reasoning.3830423746: The review explicitly raises the negative-spike scenario in 'Considered and discarded' and concludes it cannot occur, so it rejects rather than identifies the defect.
judge_reasoning.3830513980: No mention of tracked-wallet-to-tracked-wallet transfers, recordTransfer, or failing to subtract prior yield when a zero row empties a wallet; the only zero-row baseline discussion (dormant → funded) is judged correct.

1.why: daily-series.ts:67 calls value.trim() outside the try; base code (git show base) routed the same fields through numericTokenWei whose BigInt() is inside try/catch, so non-string values previously degraded to null — and reserve-yield-shared.ts:34 bigintField explicitly accepts number/bigint from this same Hasura source, so non-string is not merely hypothetical

2.why: isZeroWei returns false unless /^-?\d+$/ matches, so BigInt(trimmed) cannot throw — the try/catch at :68-71 is dead while the unguarded .trim() at :67 is the only throwing op

3.why: grep confirms balanceAmount/principalAmount only appeared in queries/reserve-yield.ts and generated types before, but the claim states a fact and names no concrete defect

4.why: use-reserve-yield-history.ts:186 does an unchecked generic requestWithTimeout and :196 pushes rows through as-is — true, but pre-existing to this change and no defect is asserted on its own

5.why: use-canonical-revenue.ts:50-53 wraps buildCanonicalRevenue in useMemo with no try/catch, so the TypeError from claim 1 propagates during render instead of setting partialReasons

6.why: confirmed no test at canonical-revenue.test.ts covers a zero→funded wallet sequence, but the seeding of 0 at :204 yields the correct daily delta, so this is a coverage suggestion with no defect

7.why: the new it.each blocks (test lines 355, 382) only pass string overrides; adding null/numeric cases is a test suggestion, not itself a defect
